errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository, revision, path or record.

ref.description: The ref or commit shown, as `ref` named it, less any path.

path.description: The directory, from the root; empty for the root.

empty.description: True for a repository never pushed, whose tree is nothing.

checks.description: The newest run of each workflow at `lastCommit`, by the runners the repository names: the revision shown, at the root.

languages.description: What the repository is written in, most first: at the root of its default branch, and nowhere else.

lastCommit.description: The newest commit that changed the directory.

ref.description: A branch, a tag or a commit; the default branch if absent. It may run on into the path, as a web address names them: the longest branch or tag that starts it is the ref, and what follows goes before `path`.

path.description: A path in the tree, from its root.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

main.description: A directory at a revision: its entries, folders first, the commit that last changed it, its README, and what the repository's runners report of the revision. Nothing at all, for a repository never pushed. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

kind.description: A directory, a file, or a submodule's commit.

html.description: A Markdown README, made into HTML: raw HTML shown as text, and links made relative to the directory.

text.description: Any other README, as it is.

readme.description: The directory's README: the first file whose name starts with `readme`, ignoring case.

description: A directory of a repository at a revision.
